departmentOnboarding.title: Department onboarding
departmentOnboarding.step1Intro: Add at least one department address (type {general} or {billing}).

departmentOnboarding.step2Intro: These values are stored via the department settings API.

departmentOnboarding.helpLine3: Time format: how times are shown (e.g. HH:mm).

departmentOnboarding.helpNote: Note: values are pre-filled sensibly; you can change them anytime in settings later.
